name: bamdude-ai
description: Read BamDude capabilities and its usage guide through a local connector.

endpoint.title: BamDude MCP address
endpoint.description: Exact https://your-farm/mcp address. Non-loopback HTTP needs the explicit trusted-network opt-in.

allow_http.title: Allow unencrypted HTTP (trusted LAN only)
allow_http.description: OFF by default. Only after accepting both HTTP warnings in BamDude settings: API keys and data will be sent in plain text. Never enable for a public network or Internet-facing address. HTTPS certificates are still verified.

api_key.title: BamDude MCP key
api_key.description: A separate MCP-enabled API key. Never enter it in chat.

ca_file.title: Trusted CA file (optional)
ca_file.description: PEM CA file for a self-signed LAN server. Its certificate must match the hostname or IP.
